subject.title: fix(subagent): resolve runtime model from subagent default instead of parent primary

question: Should spawned subagents ignore the parent session’s persisted `/model` override and use configured subagent defaults unless the child has a direct override or durable model lock?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but it changes an existing upgrade-visible routing rule that is not currently defined by public documentation.

options.title: Configured Default Wins
options.body: Adopt this PR’s behavior and make configured subagent defaults canonical across spawned runtime and persisted-session turns.

options.title: Preserve Parent Inheritance
options.body: Keep inherited parent session overrides and narrow the patch to the remaining runtime persistence and projection defects.

recommendation.title: Configured Default Wins
recommendation.body: Adopt this PR’s behavior and make configured subagent defaults canonical across spawned runtime and persisted-session turns.
